title: Unit 2 What a day!
text: 5 Sam did not feel good. He wanted to repair Bobby's book.
6 After school, Sam repaired the book carefully. It was not easy, but he tried his best.
7 Sam walked to Bobby's house. He wanted to say sorry to Bobby.
I'm sorry. I broke your book.
No, you didn't. I broke it last week!
What did Sam get from being honest?
